content.heading: Welcome to Redbean
content.text: Redbean is a single-file web server designed for speed and portability. This guide will get you from zero to a live landing page in under 2 minutes.

content.heading: Installation
content.text:
1. Download the Redbean executable.
2. Place it in your desired directory.
3. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to execute the file.

content.heading: Running your first page
content.text:
1. Create a 'page.lua' file in the same directory.
2. Run the executable: ./redbean --port 8080
3. Open your browser at http://localhost:8080

content.heading: Customization
content.text: Redbean uses Lua for logic and SQLite for data persistence. You can modify the page.lua file to change content, handle forms, or query the database directly.

content.heading: Deployment
content.text: Since Redbean is a single file, you can ship it directly to your clients or host it on any server with minimal overhead.
